result.title: Reparameterizing Your Object Detectors for Weight Space Programming
result.summary: Weight-Space Programming (WSP) edits network weights without backpropagation, yet directly editing converged object detectors stalls or collapses because set prediction penalizes duplicate boxes as false positives while compact parameterizations trap weights in an isotropic Euclidean minimum. We propose Inverse-Reparameterized Object-Detection WSP (IR-ODWSP), lifting detector layers via exact function-preserving operators (E, C) into decoupled moment, 2D-DCT, PCA, and Stiefel-Procrustes subspaces. Solving winner-exclusive updates and folding back (Delta Params=0%, Delta FLOPs=0%) induces an anisotropic Riemannian metric, improving all 26/26 MS COCO settings across 17 YOLO26, EdgeCrafter, and RF-DETR detectors (up to +0.31 APs), +1.42 mAP cross-basin COCO-O, zeroimage repair (+2.95 mAP), and label-free weather adaptation (+2.79 AP). Without retraining, IR-ODWSP supports -100% to +100% latency budgets across bridged contraction, 1.00x folding, dynamic (IR-ODWSP-DYN), and static (IR-ODWSP-SG) graphs: -10% retains 51.62 AP / 33.48 mAP, while positive budgets scale monotonically (+0.30 AP at +10%, +1.12 on RF-DETR-N; 54.83 AP at +100%; 55.91 AP / 35.44 mAP in IR-ODWSP+). Source code is released at https://github.com/WongKinYiu/ODWSP.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 IR-ODWSP，将目标检测器各层通过函数保持算子提升到矩、2D-DCT、PCA 与 Stiefel-Procrustes 等解耦子空间，在不反向传播、零额外参数与 FLOPs 的前提下完成权重空间编辑，实现检测器修复、跨域与延迟预算调节。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「把内部参数提升到结构化子空间并在各向异性度量下编辑」的思路，可能为 LVR 中免训练的 latent 状态修改与表示几何（子空间分解、度量选择）提供类比线索；但任务是目标检测、不涉及多模态推理，迁移性需核查。
